title: Research: exhibit a literal mixed566 common-cut36 counterexample
body:
## Summary

PR3368 left the mixed 5,6,6 common-cut 36 case open. This package gives a literal coefficient-realizable counterexample over every characteristic-zero field, making its conditional sufficient threshold 35 optimal under the predecessor premises.

```text
A2 live union 78 - one common cut 36 = three disjoint sections 10+16+16
binary support ranks 5,6,6; c_a=q2+q3; c_b=q1-q2
exact code/piece/joint ranks 8,3,9 give intersection dimension 2
```

All indices, signed values and the one cut are in WITNESS.json. The proof and independent checker cover all 76 retained coordinates, including 34 common zero sites. Only the canonical geometry is an external mathematical input; PR3368's explanatory proof is retained verbatim with its exact source binding.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3368's cut35 theorem left the E6 incidence equality at cut 36 unresolved. Neither an equality relaxation nor a failed search supplied a counterexample.
- **After:** exact rational matrix ranks 8,3,9 and separately reconstructed integer coefficient constraints of rank 6 in 8 variables establish intersection dimension 2. The separate checker rebuilds roots and labels without importing the primary checker or geometry source.
- Standard-library CPython 3.12.15 registered replay passes. The controls accept the original and a valid sign change, reject nine actual CLI mutants, and reject two altered/linked-source fixtures. Optimized controls propagate `-O` to the actual verifier children. Ruff check and format check pass.
- Exact committed-byte/source-history checks pass at `9da44ba1893ce518999ee3854ef17436e5269f61`. All four actual optimized scripts pass on a regular-only, read-only Git-free export; all 17 exported file hashes remain unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-mixed566-cut36-witness
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-mixed566-cut36-witness --check-source-history
```

Credit Nick Petalas's PR3368/3353/3325/3299/3295/3324/3292, sharp A2 incidence20 and the retained PR3278/3269/3267/3260/3262, David Arias, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154, joaqcoo and E8/P112/root-simplex lineage. New work is Apache-2.0. Automated assistance was used during research and implementation.

The counterexample does not need the predecessor's capacity, concentration or Weyl premises. The combined sharp-35 statement remains conditional on that predecessor theorem. No caller exclusion, full C5, native/physical consumer, supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Historical capacity/cut35 heavy replays, Lean, Docker, selected cold replay, independent human/proof-kernel review and hosted CI are unrun.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only the new research package is added. Frozen predecessors, shared verifiers and selected science are unchanged.
